ruling.reasoning:
This is a RydeTAXI trip, so the fare is metered and extra kilometres reach the rider; the two off-route segments F3 and F4 must each be reviewed under RD-1 [F3][F4][RD-1]. F1/F2 show a large overall deviation (+5.3 km, +37%, +7.6 min), but the amount is fixed by RD-2: for metered service only the extra_km of unexempted segments, at the trip's per-km rate of $27.52 ÷ 19.52 km = $1.4098/km [F1][F2][F8][RD-2].

Segment F4 (18:26–18:31, +1.70 km) is settled: the chat record is complete and fully timestamped with only the 18:12 driver proposal and the 18:13 rider reply, both before 18:17, so no rider message precedes the 18:26:25 segment start [F9][F10][F11][F4]. The driver's post-trip statement "the second turn-off was my GPS rerouting" is a claim, not rider consent under RD-5/G11 [F12], and RD-4 gives no exemption: no qualifying incident was recorded on the replaced stretch [F15] and the band 4/band 5 readings are neither band 1 nor band 2 [F13][F14][RD-4]. F4 counts and its 1.70 km is refundable [F4][RD-2][RD-4][RD-5].

Segment F3 (18:17–18:23, +2.98 km) is not settled on this record: the rider's 18:13 "Sure, no problem." [F10] is a rider message sent before the 18:17 segment start [F3] in answer to the driver's 18:12 proposal to go "round via Lower Delta Road" [F9], i.e. an agreement to a specific named road, which under RD-5 covers driving on that road only and requires the record to tie the segment to it. Nothing in the fact table ties F3 to Lower Delta Road — no stop on it, no message placing the car on it, no road name for the driven path — and the driver's statement does not place the segment there either [F12]. Timing alone does not tie them, so the scope is undetermined (G13), not exempt [F9][F10][F12][RD-5]. RD-3(a) gives no help either way: no stop is recorded in either segment [F3][F4][RD-3].

Because the F3 finding is undetermined and it changes the amount, the record does not let me fix the refund: on F4 alone the figure would be 1.70 km × $1.4098/km = $2.3967 ≈ $2.40 [F4][F5][RD-2], while if F3 also counts the figure would be 4.68 km × $1.4098/km = $6.5979 ≈ $6.60 [F3][F4][F5][RD-2]. A person must decide, so the ruling is escalate and the amount is null; the $0.11 meter waiting amount for 0.4 min is chargeable meter waiting under RD-3(c) and is not in issue [F6][RD-3]. RD-6 is not triggered — 1 dispute, 0 upheld, 0 route disputes upheld in the last 90 days — so no account flag is sent [F18][RD-6].
